question: Two rival farms compared their egg production. Green Acres Farm had 194 eggs collected. A late lay added 9 more eggs. A shipment removed 143 eggs for a big order. A second lay added 62 more eggs. Finally, seven more matching coops joined, making the total eight times as large, far ahead of the rival Blue Sky Farm's 500 eggs. How many eggs did Green Acres Farm end up with?

Two teammates, Alex and Jordan, managed project loads. Alex began with 87 tasks. He added 33 new ones. He multiplied by 5 for complexity weighting. He multiplied by 4 for team members. He divided by 6 for even splitting. He divided by 2 for simplification. How many tasks per person?

A restaurant served 223 customers at opening. By morning rush, 30 more arrived. The customer count then multiplied by 9 for peak lunch. By afternoon, 19 additional customers were seated. Evening brought 27 more. Finally, the count doubled for the night shift projection. After all this, how many customers did the restaurant project for the night?

Pam baked 84 pies on each of 7 days for the county fair. Each pie weighs 800 grams. She sold 338 pies at the fair. A cafe returned 3 unsold pies to her, and a friend gave her 43 pies to sell. Quinn's bakery stall had 4 times as many pies as Pam had then. How many pies did Quinn's stall have?

A workshop had 46 tools to begin. The tools multiplied by 4 through new acquisitions. Then 32 more tools were added. But 127 tools were removed during an inventory correction. The remaining tools gained 37 more. Finally, 53 additional items arrived. A woodshop had 200 tools but separate location. How many total items does the workshop have now?

On Monday morning a nursery had 50 lavender cuttings, and a supplier delivered 54 more. By noon the head grower had divided every cutting he held into 7 rooted plugs. In the afternoon a customer returned 45 plugs. During the evening market 596 plugs were sold. Overnight the propagation bench turned each plug still on site into 5 new plugs. How many plugs does the nursery have now?

A student had 96 notes initially. They added 29, reaching 125. They added 27 more, reaching 152. They removed 131 duplicates, leaving 21. They multiplied by 9 to 189 notes. They divided equally into 3 study groups of 63 each. How many notes per group?

A warehouse had 208 items. They subtracted 58 items removed. They multiplied by 8 for volume projection. They subtracted 870 items completed. They added 22 items recovered. Finally, 23 items were added. Using minutes and hours for time conversion, what is the final count?

Sophie started her lemonade stand with $42 in the cash box, which is 4200 cents. During a summer fair, first five nearby stands and then eight more identical stalls each pooled in an amount equal to what she currently had, growing her cash box to five times, and then eight times, its size. Unfortunately, she had to pay $1,451 to replace a broken cooler and canopy. A generous donor then added $73 to the box. The fair organizers split the remaining shared fund evenly between her stand and one partner stand, so she kept half. Finally, she paid $94 in rent for the stall space. How much money did Sophie end up with?
A business had 187 items. They added 9. They removed 69. They added 65. They had a dozen extra items. They added 32. They removed 129. How many items?

A school had 205 tablets in its charging trolley. 42 of them were sent away for repair and 128 were signed out by classes for the term. The tablets that were left were shared equally among the 5 after-school clubs. One club then had 4 of its tablets taken back by the office for an exam. The trolley itself cost 900 dollars. How many tablets does that club have?

Fay ordered 5 boxes of candles with 66 candles in each box and split them equally among her 3 shops. Each shop sold all of its candles at 6 dollars apiece, and the money from the High Street shop was divided equally among its 4 partners. The candles are 20 centimetres tall. Gil, one of those partners, then received a 79-dollar bonus on top of his share. How many dollars did Gil receive in total?

A swimming pool records its sessions in minutes and posts the timetable in hours. The pool had 102 kickboards in its store, and 47 were taken to the teaching pool. A school then borrowed 10 more. Each kickboard still in the store is stacked with 4 floats, and every float is cut from 2 foam blocks. How many foam blocks are in the store's floats?

Yui's bakery bakes 8 trays of pastries every morning with 177 pastries on each tray. Zac's bakery, which is much bigger, bakes twice as many pastries each morning as Yui's does. This morning Zac gave 228 pastries to a homeless shelter, sold 2305 pastries to customers, and threw away 257 pastries that had burned. How many pastries does Zac have left?

Sofia's coin jar held 198 coins. She spent 179 coins at the arcade and lost 9 coins on the bus. Her father then gave her 33 coins, and she found 65 coins in an old coat. Her friend Luis has fewer coins in his jar than Sofia. How many coins are in Sofia's jar now?

A business had 226 dollars (morning). They added 22 (morning). They subtracted 211 for inventory (mid-morning). They multiplied by 8 for growth projection (afternoon). They subtracted 171 for operating cost. They multiplied by 8 more (evening). They added 29 final profit. Using 'double' as a word quantity and showing 'Tom and Sarah' as named managers. After addition but before first large subtraction, how much money in the late morning?

A print shop is making booklets of 73 pages each, and it needs 9 booklets for one set. It adds 50 cover and title pages to each set. The shop prints 2 copies of each set, and it must send the copies to 2 different schools, so it prints the whole order once for each school. It also prints 12 spare pages. How many pages does the shop print altogether?

A student starts their savings with 17 dollars. They lose 3 dollars to a friend. They earn 65 dollars from work. To plan for future spending, they multiply their amount by 4. They receive 37 dollars from their parents. They earn 65 dollars from selling textbooks. They have been saving for six months. If they convert their total to cents, how many cents do they have?

A student had 119 items. They added 10 items. They added 20 items. They multiplied by 8 times. They tripled them. They added 52 items. They multiplied by 4 times. The total progressed. How many items?
Two players combined their marbles: 232 total. Player A added 40 more marbles. Both lost 57 marbles. Both lost another 175. Player B added 68 marbles to his half. How many marbles does Player B have?

A hotel laundry records its machine time in minutes and bills it to guests in hours. On Monday the linen store held 155 towels, and a delivery added 69 more. Housekeeping then took 130 towels out to the rooms. A wash returned 26 towels to the store, and a guest handed back 3 more. Each towel now in the store is packed into a welcome basket with 8 small soaps. How many soaps go into the baskets altogether?

Mira busks in the subway and counts her takings in cents, though the busking permit fee is quoted in dollars and she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. On Monday she earned 222 cents in each of 5 hours of playing, and then some passers-by dropped in 23 cents, 24 cents and 37 cents as she packed up. Her guitar has 6 strings. She spent 698 cents on dinner on the way home. Mira ended each of 7 days with exactly the same amount as Monday and saved all of it. How many cents did she save over those 7 days?

A canoe club had 58 paddles in its shed, and a grant paid for 70 more. A flood then damaged 116 paddles beyond repair. The club bought enough paddles to make the number in the shed 2 times as large, and a merger with another club made it 2 times as large again. Each paddle is stored with 7 spare bolts. All of the bolts were shared equally among the shed's 6 tool boxes. The club has 90 members. How many bolts are in one tool box?

Two colleagues compared resource allocation. Starting: 52 units. Subtracted 36 for phase one. Subtracted 10 more for phase two. Multiplied by 2 for redundancy. Multiplied by 9 for total allocation. Converting to hours at half-dozen per hour. How many total hours of work equivalent?
A factory had 223 units. They multiplied by 4. They removed 834. They multiplied by 9. They added 25 more. They removed 335. They multiplied by 9. How many units?
